function.name: add_todo
function.description: Add a new todo entry to the CSV file at file_path. Returns True if the entry was added successfully, False otherwise.

todo.description: The text description of the todo item.

priority.description: Priority of the todo item. Must be one of: low, medium, high, critical.

status.description: Status of the todo item. If not provided, defaults to pending.

created_at.description: Timestamp for when the todo was created, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

completed_at.description: Timestamp for when the todo was completed, in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file where the todo item will be added.
